headline: Raw history-aware BT4 labeling advances the intended G10 inputs; the aligned SF observation/derived-rank/join qualification is not prepared yet.

counts.complete_phase0_d9_plus_bt4_rows: unknown from existing counters; no all-row d9 completeness/legal coverage receipt

count_definitions.closed_source: Unique names in complete captured generator-progress lines; unlisted/in-flight files excluded.
count_definitions.receipt_backed_bt4: Distinct source_id/source_shard/physical-row identities with completed raw BT4 receipts, matching sidecar attrs/five array layouts, source manifest/config, raw file size+mtime, history and ONNX identities. No directory-count completeness inference.
count_definitions.distinctness: Not globally deduplicated chess positions. Cross-run game IDs require the source namespace; no row fingerprint payloads were scanned.
count_definitions.full_transfer_qualification: No completed G10 derived replay source + selected SF d9/rank alignment + raw-BT4 join + matched recipes/schedule qualification exists at the configured destinations. Existing old20M qualification is separate and is not counted as new G10.

active_labeling.selection: Closed shards only, ordered by raw mtime/source_id/shard name across both runs; no phase-dependent or outcome-dependent row filter. Raw history inputs are verified before inference.
active_labeling.why: Both source runs are the intended history/schema3 G10 generation and the raw policies retain source/config/shard/fingerprint identities. Teacher temperature is applied later, so these priors can support C/H/global/BT4-only variants without new inference. They do not provide independent SF rank validation.

observation_selectors.source_and_run: run06_g10 / nnue_bootstrap_run06_g10 (seed20260902,12workers,520000games) and run07_g10_companion4 / nnue_bootstrap_run07_g10_companion4 (seed20260903,4workers,130000games). Both schema3/history_rep_fixtrue; banked pieces>=7; same engine/book/cp mapping.
observation_selectors.generator: all:9,8:10,4:12; full legal phase0 d9, narrowed phase1 d10 top8, phase2 d12 top4 only when d10 top1-top2 gap<=10cp; tables carried within games. Generator can bank incomplete/fallback final depth blocks, so intended all:9 is not a counted proof of complete d9 for every row.
observation_selectors.default_deriver: uniform-d9 obtains each move value from the latest phase containing depth9; --value-depth9 alone does not force phase0. Policy/value observation selection is not currently exposed as an explicit fixed-depth phase0 selector.
observation_selectors.rank_tool: sf_d9_rank_sidecar.d9_lines requires exactly one complete phase0 d9 block and rank/legal consistency; it expects a particular derived source/shuffle/row contract.
observation_selectors.required_transfer_choice: Declare and stamp one SF observation convention for policy, root value, near-close ranks and any independent cp-quality rewards. A phase0-d9 transfer best preserves the old observation type, but not the old generator search state or data distribution. Legacy latest-phase d9 is a different deliberate treatment.

smallest_preparation_gap: Preregister a source-qualified common snapshot/subset of already receipt-backed G10 shards, including both source namespaces and all row selectors; do not freeze current in-flight shards.

On a bounded bank, qualify complete legal phase0 d9 coverage, result eligibility, and phase0 versus latest-phase policy/value/rank changes. Existing one-row evidence proves a difference can occur, not its prevalence.

Implement/qualify an explicit SF observation selector and a raw-BT4-to-derived replay join that carries original source_id/shard/row/game/ply fingerprints through filtering and per-shard shuffle; the current raw sidecar format is not directly the derived-sidecar format consumed by the mixer.

Derive the matched source and corresponding rank/BT4 sidecars once on that shared row set, record exclusions and exact identities, then materialize chosen recipes with unchanged non-policy/value treatment and verify canonical schedules.

For a G10-only35M transfer, current frozen progress lacks4,368,161closed raw rows and10,075,308BT4-labeled rows before any eligibility drops. Existing18.9Msource could count toward a separately declared combined corpus, but that is a mixture/design decision and does not bypass the G10 alignment gap.
limits: No source/sidecar policy payload scan, large payload hashes, GPU probe, tests, label/generator changes, or pipeline implementation.
Readiness counts are a bounded append-only prefix observation, not an atomic global snapshot or an estimate of eventual valid/deduplicated training rows.
No completed SF d9/rank qualification count can be inferred from source directory or BT4 receipt count.
No implication that waiting for35M alone resolves observation/join semantics.
